newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's economic performance index up 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel's economic performance index up 0.1 pct.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index rose 0.1 percent in January, the Bank of Israel said on Wednesday.

The "S" index is made up of four components: retail sales, which rose 3.6 percent in January; imports, which rose 1.2 percent in January and industrial production, which lags the other sub-indices by one month and rose 2.6 percent in December.
The Bank of Israel gave no figures on the fourth component, work shifts.
The rise marks a turnaround for the index, which fell 1.3 percent in the last quarter of 1996, the central bank said.
